prompt.task: Log in to Default Browser and go to airbnb.com/login with username {user} and password {password}. You are authorized to perform 2FA if required. Don't stop until you successful login.

auto_verifier.reason: Start evidence shows no foreground Airbnb session; the continuous log records navigation to airbnb.com/login, submission of the specified email and password through Airbnb's alternate-password route, and transition to an authenticated profile. Final screenshot/XML show airbnb.com/users/profile for {account_name} with Past trips, Account settings, Messages, and Log out.
